decisions.reason: As a direct extension of the firm's core cloud messaging offer in a growing market, it is likely at or above aspiration levels and slack favors continued support rather than withdrawal.

Its dedicated positioning and cited customer use suggest observable acceptance, so relative to aspirations it looks good enough to keep while the firm continues investing in digital workflow services.

Although more niche and somewhat exposed to shifts away from fax, it still leverages established capabilities and customer needs, so under bounded rationality we would continue it unless results clearly fall below aspirations.

This is a close-in feature for the installed base, and because it likely requires limited additional resources, available organizational slack supports keeping it despite a mature fax-related segment.
Security add-ons fit the firm's compliant messaging position and likely compare reasonably to aspirations, so management would keep it unless stronger evidence of underperformance emerged.
